bio: Inspired by the remarkable French institution La Colombe d’Or and the poetic stylings of Villa Santo Sospir, take a seat in Socca’s serene salons, where charming murals and handpicked artistry paint the perfect backdrop for an exquisite afternoon of artistic indulgence.  Delicately styled across three tiered stands, a splendid selection of French and British culinary delights await. Sample seasonal savouries such as ‘Crab Quiche’ and the delicate ‘Duck Rillette Finger Sandwich’. For something sweet, enjoy an exquisite ensemble of pretty pastel pastries including Yorkshire Rhubarb and Lemon Meringue Pie, all of which are paired alongside a carefully curated menu of teas an exclusive assortment of Champagnes.  L’Amour du Thé is available 2.30pm-4.30pm Monday – Saturday and can be enjoyed in either the larger light-filled Grand Salon at the front of the restaurant, or Le Petit Salon, nestled discreetly at the restaurant's rear, decorated with layered murals and softly illuminated by silk sconces.
